title: Controlled source packet: domain and evidence brief
excerpt: The software study concerns suggestions for Python code review. A test suite can check the supplied examples but cannot prove program correctness for every input. Reviewers will receive the code and a short issue description. The assistant will suggest changes; a developer retains the final decision.

title: Controlled source packet: experimental design brief
excerpt: The planned sample contains 36 small functions. Both review conditions receive the same functions and issue descriptions. One condition produces a free-form suggestion, and the other must identify an exact edit location. Passing tests is necessary but is not sufficient for accepting a suggestion.
